settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse: Thoroughly cleanse your face to remove any impurities.
  2. Apply Mask: Place the sheet mask over your face, ensuring it covers from forehead to chin.
  3. Connect Electrodes: Insert the lead wire into the two sticky pads and connect them to your MyoLift device.
  4. Position Electrodes: Apply the sticky pad electrodes over the sheet mask—one between the eyebrows and one on the décolleté.
  5. Activate Device: Set your device to the appropriate setting:
  • MyoLift QT: Lowest level
  • MyoLift Mini & MyoLift 600: Level 1 on Educate
  • MyoLift MD: Lowest level on Educate or Iontophoresis
  1. Relax: Leave the mask on for 15-20 minutes until the serum is fully absorbed.
  2. Remove: Gently remove the mask and electrodes.

Post-Treatment Care: Follow with our anti-aging peptide serum for added benefits

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Enhances Skin Texture & Elasticity: EGF stimulates cell growth and repair, improving skin firmness.
  • Deep Hydration: Sodium Hyaluronate attracts moisture, plumping the skin and reducing fine lines.
  • Antioxidant Protection: Ginkgo Biloba Leaf Extract provides over 49 antioxidants, combating free radicals and promoting skin health.
  • Supports Post-Treatment Recovery: Ideal for use after procedures like chemical peels, microneedling, or microcurrent therapy.
